# 消防接处警 GIS 控制-接口映射表（核心精简版）

**版本**：1.0  
**更新日期**：2026-06-24  
**用途**：前后端接口定义、Mock 数据设计、联调对照

---

## 映射总表（31项控制）

| 阶段 | 控制ID | 控制名称 | 类型 | EventKey（接口名） | 核心输入字段（Input） | 核心输出字段（Output） | 备注/状态 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **初始化** | `GC-01` | 资源配置 | 内部配置 | - | `layers: {id, visible}[]` | - | 系统启动加载 |
| **初始化** | `GC-02` | 地图基础参数 | 内部配置 | - | `defaultCenter, defaultZoom, minZoom, maxZoom` | - | - |
| **初始化** | `GC-03` | 搜索栏配置 | 内部配置 | - | `enabled, fuzzySearch, sources, maxResults` | - | - |
| **初始化** | `GC-04` | 工具栏配置 | 内部配置 | - | `controls: {id, visible}[]` | - | - |
| **初始化** | `GC-05` | 控件显隐 | 内部配置 | - | `scaleControl, compassControl, miniMap` | - | - |
| **初始化** | `GC-06` | 动态对象清除策略 | 内部配置 | - | `clearOnCaseClose, keepHistoryCount, memoryThreshold` | - | - |
| **初始化** | `GC-07` | 业务面板配置 | 内部配置 | - | `autoOpen25D, linkSelectWithPanel` | - | - |
| **值守** | `C001` | 图层显隐控制 | 外部控制 | `layer.set.visible` | `layerId, visible` | - | - |
| **值守** | `C002` | WMS图层刷新 | 外部控制 | `layer.refresh` | `layerId, timestamp, bbox` | - | - |
| **值守** | `C003` | 地图视图变更通知 | 输出控制 | `map.view.changed` | - | `center, zoom, rotation, bounds` | 自动推送 |
| **来电** | `C004` | 来电定位控制 | 外部控制 | `map.locate` | `lngLat, zoom, radius, poiTypes, showPoiIcon, duration` | - | 增强：支持POI类型筛选 |
| **来电** | `C005` | 坐标拾取控制 | 输出控制 | `map.click` | - | `lngLat, pixel, featureId, layerId` | 用户点击 |
| **接警** | `C006` | 警情精确上图控制 | 外部控制 | `alarm.update` | `alarmId, lngLat, address, aoiList, fitBounds` | - | 增强：支持AOI围栏 |
| **接警** | `C007` | 围栏缩圈控制 | 内部控制 | - | （由C006触发） | - | 自动缩圈 |
| **接警** | `C008` | ES资源检索控制 | 内/外部 | `resource.query` | `geometry(Polygon), resourceTypes[], size` | `queryId, total, resources[]` | 多边形查询（消防栓/重点单位） |
| **接警** | `C023` | AOI围栏高亮控制 | 外部控制 | `aoi.highlight` | `alarmId, aoiList[], fitBounds, strokeColor` | - | 新增 |
| **接警** | `C024` | POI查询上图控制 | 外部控制 | `poi.query` | `lngLat, radius, poiTypes[], limit, iconStyle` | - | 新增 |
| **研判** | `C009` | 路径规划请求控制 | 外部控制 | `route.plan.request` | `requestId, start{id,lngLat}, end{lngLat}, strategy, vehicleId` | - | - |
| **研判** | `C010` | 路径规划结果输出控制 | 输出控制 | `route.plan.result` | - | `requestId, path[], distance, duration` | 响应C009 |
| **研判** | `C011` | 2.5D白膜加载控制 | 外部控制 | `overlay.open`(扩展) | `alarmId, lngLat, highlightFloor, totalFloors` | - | - |
| **调度** | `C012` | 调派初始化控制 | 外部控制 | `dispatch.init` | `requestId, alarmInfo, standbyVehicles[]` | - | 批量车辆上图+路径 |
| **调度** | `C013` | 车辆添加上图控制 | 外部控制 | `dispatch.vehicle.add` | `requestId, vehicle{id, plateNo, lonlat}` | - | 单辆添加 |
| **调度** | `C014` | 车辆移除控制 | 外部控制 | `dispatch.vehicle.remove` | `requestId, vehicleId` | - | 移除车辆及路径 |
| **调度** | `C015` | 批量移除车辆控制 | 外部控制 | `dispatch.vehicle.remove.batch` | `requestId, stationId, vehicleIds[]` | - | 新增 |
| **调度** | `C016` | 方案显示切换控制 | 外部控制 | `dispatch.vehicle.plan.toggle` | `requestId, vehicleIds[], visible` | - | 草案待细化 |
| **调度** | `C017` | 联动单位过滤控制 | 外部控制 | `dispatch.linked_unit.filter` | `requestId, types[]` | - | 空数组隐藏全部 |
| **执行** | `C018` | 车辆位置更新控制 | 外部控制 | `dispatch.vehicle.move` | `vehicleId, lonlat, timestamp, speed, direction` | - | 新增，实时GPS |
| **执行** | `C019` | 轨迹更新控制 | 内部控制 | - | （由C018触发） | - | 自动追加历史轨迹 |
| **执行** | `C020` | 警情状态流转控制 | 内部控制 | - | （由调派确认触发） | - | 状态机流转 |
| **执行** | `C021` | 历史轨迹回放控制 | 外部控制 | `dispatch.vehicle.history` | `requestId, vehicleId, points[], playSpeed` | - | 新增，复盘用 |
| **执行** | `C022` | 车辆拾取控制 | 输出控制 | `dispatch.vehicle.pick` | - | `pickId, vehicle{id, plateNo, lonlat}` | 用户点击车辆 |

---

## 简版 JSON Schema（核心字段）

```json
{
  "definitions": {
    "LngLat": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "number" }, "minItems": 2, "maxItems": 2 },
    "GeometryPolygon": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "type": { "enum": ["Polygon"] },
        "coordinates": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "number" } } } }
      }
    },
    "AoiItem": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "id": { "type": "string" },
        "name": { "type": "string" },
        "geometry": { "$ref": "#/definitions/GeometryPolygon" }
      }
    },
    "Vehicle": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "id": { "type": "string" },
        "plateNo": { "type": "string" },
        "lonlat": { "$ref": "#/definitions/LngLat" },
        "carType": { "type": "string" },
        "status": { "type": "string" }
      }
    },
    "AlarmInfo": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "id": { "type": "string" },
        "lonlat": { "$ref": "#/definitions/LngLat" },
        "address": { "type": "string" },
        "type": { "type": "string" }
      }
    }
  },
  "events": {
    "map.locate": {
      "input": { "lngLat": "#/definitions/LngLat", "zoom": "number", "radius": "number", "poiTypes": "string[]", "showPoiIcon": "boolean" }
    },
    "alarm.update": {
      "input": { "alarmId": "string", "lngLat": "#/definitions/LngLat", "address": "string", "aoiList": "#/definitions/AoiItem[]" }
    },
    "resource.query": {
      "input": { "geometry": "#/definitions/GeometryPolygon", "resourceTypes": "string[]", "size": "number" },
      "output": { "queryId": "string", "total": "number", "resources": "array" }
    },
    "route.plan.request": {
      "input": { "requestId": "string", "start": { "id": "string", "lngLat": "#/definitions/LngLat" }, "end": { "lngLat": "#/definitions/LngLat" }, "strategy": "string" }
    },
    "route.plan.result": {
      "output": { "requestId": "string", "path": "array", "distance": "number", "duration": "number" }
    },
    "dispatch.init": {
      "input": { "requestId": "string", "alarmInfo": "#/definitions/AlarmInfo", "standbyVehicles": "#/definitions/Vehicle[]" }
    },
    "dispatch.vehicle.add": {
      "input": { "requestId": "string", "vehicle": "#/definitions/Vehicle" }
    },
    "dispatch.vehicle.remove": {
      "input": { "requestId": "string", "vehicleId": "string" }
    },
    "dispatch.vehicle.remove.batch": {
      "input": { "requestId": "string", "stationId": "string", "vehicleIds": "string[]" }
    },
    "dispatch.vehicle.move": {
      "input": { "vehicleId": "string", "lonlat": "#/definitions/LngLat", "timestamp": "number", "speed": "number" }
    },
    "dispatch.vehicle.history": {
      "input": { "requestId": "string", "vehicleId": "string", "points": "array", "playSpeed": "number" }
    },
    "dispatch.vehicle.pick": {
      "output": { "pickId": "string", "vehicle": "#/definitions/Vehicle" }
    },
    "aoi.highlight": {
      "input": { "alarmId": "string", "aoiList": "#/definitions/AoiItem[]", "fitBounds": "boolean" }
    },
    "poi.query": {
      "input": { "lngLat": "#/definitions/LngLat", "radius": "number", "poiTypes": "string[]", "limit": "number" }
    },
    "layer.set.visible": {
      "input": { "layerId": "string", "visible": "boolean" }
    },
    "layer.refresh": {
      "input": { "layerId": "string", "timestamp": "number", "bbox": "number[]" }
    },
    "map.view.changed": {
      "output": { "center": "#/definitions/LngLat", "zoom": "number", "rotation": "number", "bounds": "object" }
    },
    "map.click": {
      "output": { "lngLat": "#/definitions/LngLat", "pixel": "object", "featureId": "string" }
    }
  }
}
